label: Plato, Theaetetus 170d-171a: Someone opines the denial of the measure thesis: the many who think…
interpretation: Whenever someone declares a judgement, countless others oppose it, thinking that he judges falsely (170d); applied at 171a to Protagoras's own thesis, which the many do not share and whose opponents "think that he is wrong". Read as: someone opines the denial of the measure thesis. Not read as a census claim that most people deny it, though 171a also says that.
